calendarSpread.note: FC6 far-minus-near spread and the continuous annualized rate between two deliveries

commodityBasis.note: FC6 spot-minus-futures basis and basisFraction — two different quantities, both named

commodityCarry.note: FC6 implied annualized carry with the parity residual made visible when all three components are supplied

commodityForwardPrice.note: FC6 ratified plain by the core capability spec (2026-08-19): the frozen cost-of-carry first touch — a bare-number primitive, the shape is the decision

commodityForwardValue.note: FC6 current value of an existing forward: ±(current − contract) × quantity × explicit discount factor

convertCommodityQuantity.note: FC6 explicit-factor unit conversion — the engine never invents conversion factors

curveSpreadAnalytics.note: FC6 per-adjacent-pair spread rows plus the front-to-back figures

futuresHedgeRatio.note: FC6 contracts required — real-valued; rounding is the caller's execution decision, disclosed

impliedConvenienceYield.note: FC6 inverse of the cost-of-carry forward solved for the convenience yield

impliedStorageCost.note: FC6 inverse of the cost-of-carry forward solved for the proportional storage rate

rollReturnDecomposition.note: FC6 exact multiplicative decomposition: (1+total) = (1+spotMove) × (1+carryConvergence); roll leg stated separately

rollYield.note: FC6 long-roll yield with the sign law stated; spot-relative decomposition only when spot is observed

seasonalityProfile.note: FC6 per-calendar-month statistic over caller history; empty months null-with-reason, thin months warned

termStructureState.note: FC6 contango/backwardation/flat/indeterminate under a required explicit tolerance, mixes disclosed
